ring.qualification: Ring dimensions and the 0.5 opacity from the 2017 occultation (Ortiz et al. 2017). No ring color is measured: it is the neutral gray of a body without a measured color.

science.qualification: Uniform whole-disc color and V geometric albedo from published photometry; the surface is unresolved and no map is implied.
An artist's surface from NASA's Haumea 3D model, carried through the model's own texture coordinates; not an observation.
